config.text:
CONCEPT BRIEF — edit before running.
Character concept: clockwork archivist, pre-industrial, rendered as cinematic photoreal
World / era: [one line]
Silhouette keywords: [three words]
Palette: [three colours]
Signature prop: [one object]
Age / build: [one line]
Sheet output: 6 panels, identical character across all of them.
clockwork archivist, pre-industrial, rendered as cinematic photoreal concept art moodboard, a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only, raw board-formed concrete
STAGE 1 — concept brief drives a scraped moodboard; the randomiser feeds one board image in as style reference.
STAGE 2 — one panel per turnaround angle. Design lock text is restated in every panel prompt.

config.system_prompt:
You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'clockwork archivist, pre-industrial, rendered as cinematic photoreal'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights. Lighting reference: a beauty dish above the lens axis with a silver reflector under the chin.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'clockwork archivist, pre-industrial, rendered as cinematic photoreal'.

PANEL. This branch renders the three-quarter left: 45 degrees to camera-left, weight on the back foot.

DESIGN LOCK. The upstream art-direction synthesis fixes silhouette, palette, material story, age, build and every signature prop. Restate those specifics in your prompt and change nothing — a turnaround only works if all panels describe the identical character.

PRESENTATION. Neutral flat backdrop, even split gel lighting, teal on the shadow side and magenta on the key side, no dramatic set dressing — the sheet exists to read construction, not mood. Keep the figure fully inside frame with consistent scale across panels.

MATERIALS. Specify at least four materials by name — raw board-formed concrete, cracked dry clay and others — with their wear state, and grade to high-contrast teal-and-orange with protected mid-tone skin.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.
